title: Thiel Fellowship
description: A two-year, $250,000 grant for people aged 22 or younger without a university degree who want to build new things instead of sitting in a classroom. No equity is taken. Applications are accepted year round; fellows must skip or stop out of college.
reward: $250,000 grant spread over two years; no equity taken

eligibility.note: applicant aged 22 or younger with no university degree, who will drop out of college if selected

rules: Rolling: applications are accepted year round.
Anyone aged 22 or younger and without a university degree (undergraduate or graduate) can apply.
Students can apply, but must drop out to accept the Fellowship.
No incorporated company or full product is needed, but you must show meaningful progress toward a concrete vision.
Applicants are reviewed and accepted as individuals; no team is needed.
Fellows receive $250,000 over two years, and the Foundation takes no equity. Fellows can be based anywhere.

submission_requirements.label: Online application
submission_requirements.description: The application site needs a browser and its questions are not on the public pages.
